data.title: Donald Trump: Iran largely destroyed, US ready to ‘finish the job’ if needed | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "I would rather not destroy the rest of the country if possible," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office following a meeting with his national security advisers, "but maybe I'll have to."
